content: Supabase CLI workflow: supabase init scaffolds supabase/ (config.toml, migrations/, seed.sql). supabase migration new <name> creates a timestamped SQL file; supabase db reset replays all local migrations + seed.sql against local Postgres container; supabase link connects to remote project; supabase db push applies pending local migrations to remote; supabase db pull baselines an existing remote schema into a migration file for brownfield adoption.
